alt: A short film with no voice. A lavender bedroom. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes sits on the bed beside a phone, proudly next to a sign that says BOUNDARIES. The phone buzzes. Its eyes go wide, the sign vanishes, it nudges the phone toward itself and its eyes turn happy. At the end it looks at the camera with narrowed eyes. The text stays: me: i have boundaries. The person who hurt me: 'hey'. Me: hi!!
